en.headline: Police arrest six over 25 burglaries worth HK$3.69 million
en.dek: Officers said a two-way permit couple are accused of arranging illegal entrants to break into village houses in several districts.
body: Police have arrested six people, five men and one woman aged 31 to 45, in connection with 25 burglaries across several districts, with losses put at more than HK$3.69 million, RTHK reported on Saturday.

Officers said the group had a clear division of roles. A couple holding two-way permits are accused of acting as the organisers, arranging for mainland men to enter Hong Kong illegally and recruiting a local driver to take them to target areas and hiding places. Three of those arrested are accused of being illegal entrants. Police said they do not rule out further arrests.

Acting chief inspector Ng Sze-hin of the New Territories North regional crime unit said the group is believed to have been active since late August, linked to cases in Yuen Long, Tuen Mun, Tai Po, Sai Kung, Ma On Shan and Aberdeen. Twenty-three of the cases involved village houses or detached houses, often quiet units near hillsides, with doors or windows forced or found unlocked while residents were out. The largest single loss, about HK$600,000, was at a flat in Aberdeen. Police said they had recovered cash, jewellery, watches and handbags worth more than HK$600,000.

zh.headline: 警方拘6人 涉25宗爆竊損失逾369萬元
zh.dek: 警方指一對持雙程證夫婦涉嫌安排非法入境者，到多區村屋爆竊，不排除再有人被捕。
body: 港台周六報道，警方拘捕5男1女，年齡介乎31至45歲，涉嫌與多區25宗爆竊案有關，損失總值超過369萬港元。
警方表示，集團分工明確，一對持雙程證夫婦涉嫌作為主腦，安排內地男子非法入境，並招募本地男子擔任車手，接載他們到目標區域及藏身地點。被捕者包括3名被指非法入境的內地男子。警方不排除會再有人被捕。
新界北總區重案組署理總督察吳斯軒表示，相信集團自8月下旬開始活躍，與元朗、屯門、大埔、西貢、馬鞍山及香港仔的案件有關。其中23宗涉及村屋或獨立屋，針對較僻靜、鄰近山邊、保安較薄弱的單位，趁屋主外出時撬開或進入沒有上鎖的門窗，盜取金器、首飾及現金。香港仔一宗住宅單位損失約60萬元，是今次最大單一損失。警方稱已起回現金、首飾、手錶及手袋等，總值超過60萬元。
